visualReview.reviewer: modern_gospel_actor - direct inspection of every listed original Blender render
observations: Young hero has centre-parted flowing locks, a shorter rounded lower face, softer eyebrows and a clean ivory woven tunic with blue drape.

Idle, Walk, Run and JumpAir were directly inspected: shoulder and elbow coverage remain closed; the mantle is a single connected front/shoulder/back surface. Torso lean creates a visible cloth compression fold, not a disconnected seam.
Adult actor has separate adult proportions, beard and crimson drape. Mary has a distinct adult silhouette, full ivory veil, blue drape and longer robe.
The original source, prior models and earlier art evidence remain preserved in History/before-modern-2026-10-26; unused intermediate render angles were archived separately.
limits: Artistic depictions, not historically verified facial likenesses.
Blender reviews do not establish Unity binding/performance, physical-device execution, or user aesthetic approval.
